description: A2 (c220) GDN chunk forward (GDR, scalar per-head gate): prepare -> scores -> wy -> scan -> output. Public inputs/outputs are token-major fp32; the GQA/GVA head map, scale and layout are in-kernel. Derived from a5.gdn_chunk_fwd, re-authored for the A2 facade (tile-vector UB ops instead of @vf, GM workspace rings instead of UB->L1 / L0C->UB). The scan's two matrix contractions run on the cube (matmul + L0C->GM->UB GMBuff ring); see docs/research/a2_gdn_abi.md §7 Deviation 1.

g.note: GDR per-(token,value-head) scalar gate (log space, g<=0).

initial_state.note: Optional nonzero carry-in state (§1.3); zero state is the default.

final_state.note: fp32 key-major state after the last chunk (§1.5 shipped default; no bf16-state shipping option).

default.reason: fp32 dual-oracle (block-solve + head-local grouped recurrence). Measured o/final_state rel-L2 2.8e-7..4.2e-7 across zero and nonzero initial_state; judged in fp32, never bitwise, never bf16-elementwise (AGENTS.md §6).

domain.T: positive; T == 64*N (no tail path, §1.7); T % 64 != 0 is rejected with the nearest legal T
domain.dtype: all fp32 (no bf16-state variant; §1.5 bf16-state is reported as divergence evidence only, §4 bf16-host-audit N/A)
domain.block_dim_note: Validated at block_dim=40 (the a2 core count used throughout bring-up). A bd1-vs-bd40 comparison is unavailable: bd=1 faulted with a vector-core exception on the shared, contended 910B3. Correctness is block-dim-independent by construction (per-(b,hv) split, no cross-core reduction), but bd1 is recorded as unverified rather than asserted (AGENTS.md §2). See evidence/blockdim_sweep.log.

gate_span.note: Kernel tests use a small, safe span (<=10, far from the 88.7 line). Span calibration is a separate batch; no number is asserted.

domain.accumulate_settle: The scan carries its two contractions on the cube (matmul); every L0C-accumulate chain that is not is_init carries an explicit barrier(Pipe.M) (A2-01). The FP32/BF16 M<64 splitk form is not used.

dependencies.derived_from: a5.gdn_chunk_fwd (this repository); re-authored for the A2 facade.

support.scope: 910B3, CANN 9.2.0-beta.1, opp 9.2.0-beta.1 (ts 20260805_224858134), npu-smi 25.5.1, block_dim=40. End-to-end prepare->scores->wy->scan->output validated by tests/test_a2_gdn_chunk.py against a dual fp32 CPU oracle (block-solve + head-local grouped recurrence): o/final_state rel-L2 2.8e-7..4.2e-7 at HV!=H (H=2,HV=4), zero and nonzero initial_state; two-segment chaining bit-exact; T%64!=0 rejected. Raw numbers in evidence/acceptance_numbers.log; env in evidence/env.json.
support.note: The runnable unit.py / run.py / _unit_runner.py harness (one-op-per-process board launch, AGENTS.md §3) is not yet ported; the committed pytest is the validation of record. This contract is the declarative half. The runner port is DEFERRED to a follow-up task with PM approval (PR #138 REVIEW, 2026-10-07); until it lands this unit is NOT marked qualified in the full repo unit-protocol sense.

deviations: scan's wy@S (contract D) and knd^T@delta (contract C) run on the cube (matmul + L0C->GM->UB GMBuff ring) instead of the planned pure-vector matvec, which faults on b3 for a kernel-context reason (docs/research/a2_gdn_abi.md §7 Deviation 1). ABI and numerics unchanged.
prepare/scores/output needed explicit count= on their vector ops for b3 (sim did not model b3's vector UB-address bounds).
